15|- `protocols` holds every protocol at or above $5,000,000 of TVL, one object each, sorted by `slug`. Each call gives the entry it picks 0.5 plus a tenth of its margin (0.6 at margin 1 up to 1.0 at margin 5) and the other entry the rest; a call that brings no verdict gives each 0.5.
